text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: formal vocative opening that creates direct address before any rule is stated
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the surah as a summons, so the coming prohibition is heard as direct instruction to a defined audience rather than as detached legal description. Its long open call gives the address audible space before the identity filter arrives, and the surah begins with listener orientation before the rule itself.

topics.headline: formal address frame
topics.summary: The particle creates the speech event in which the believer group receives the prohibition and command.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by summoning an audience before issuing the rule.
topics.reason: Local grammar identifies a vocative particle governing the following addressee complex, so the opening force is direct address.

topics.headline: audible opening summons
topics.summary: The long vocative sound and opening break make the summons perceptible before the addressee is specified.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening call as a formal arresting summons, not a clipped attention marker.
topics.reason: The written particle carries the long opening call, and its position before the selector supports the audible summons payoff.

topics.headline: surah opens through address
topics.summary: The first movement is summons rather than narrative or abstract declaration.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's first mode is disciplined address, setting up later social ethics as response.
topics.reason: The ayah begins with the vocative construction, so the surah opens by forming listeners before stating the prohibition.

words.gloss_range: vocative selector that formally gates and specifies the addressed class through what follows
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) is not the full addressee by itself; it is the formal selector that waits for the following relative expression to define who is being called. Its fused selector-and-alert shape makes the audience first feel summoned and gated, then specified by belief.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the appositional completion by the relative pronoun, so the selector does not stand alone.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a staged address: selection first, then identity content.
topics.reason: The compound vocative construction raises the formality of the address and delays the defining content until the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: plural relative class marker that defines the addressees through the following belief clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) routes the audience identity through a clause, so the addressees are constituted by what they have done, not by tribe or a bare label. The plural relative form binds to the plural verb that follows, making the later restraint and taqwā a test of the same belief identity, a thread the surah later presses again in 49:14.

topics.summary: The relative pronoun makes the addressees definable by the following act of belief.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is defined by a clause of belief rather than by an inherited group label.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the relative pronoun appositional to the vocative selector and completed by the plural verb.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command sequence as testing the addressees' claimed belief, with 49:14 later revisiting that identity.
topics.reason: The relative clause defines the addressees by belief, and the same surah later reopens that identity claim in 49:14.

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) completes the address by naming the audience as those who have already entered committed belief. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field keeps trust and security pressure visible, so the coming ban on pre-empting God and messenger is not arbitrary; it demands conduct consistent with an entrusted identity. The familiar believer-address formula launches the ayah's directive arc, and the plural ending makes the identity collective while audibly linking this group to the later restrained and commanded actions. The surah later returns to belief as a tested claim in 49:14 and 49:15.

Its scope is tight, stopping the following advance verb without swallowing the later positive command, so the ayah first blocks false precedence and then can redirect the same audience toward guarding.

words.gloss_range: Form II jussive prohibition against actively putting anything forward or stepping ahead before the named authority-space; object omission keeps the prohibited matter open
words.root_gloss_range: root field of precedence, footed advance, presentation, and priority; local Form II plus the before-the-hands idiom selects active pre-emption rather than every root branch
words.prose: {{ar:تُقَدِّمُوا۟}} ({{tr:tuqaddimū}}) is a jussive prohibition, so the verb is not ordinary present action but a stopped second-person plural act. Its Form II shape makes the wrongdoing active putting-forward, while the missing object keeps what might be advanced open: a matter, speech, judgment, or initiative. The {{ar:ق د م}} ({{tr:q-d-m}}) field lets that pre-emption feel like stepping ahead, and the standard Form II surface differs from variant forms that would stress simple or reflexive preceding. The pressed middle consonant makes the act of pushing forward audible, and the general precedence ban prepares the concrete voice-restraint concern in 49:2.

words.gloss_range: first nominative predicate in the closing seal, presenting stable intensive divine hearing of the audible dimension of pre-emption
words.root_gloss_range: root field of hearing, listening, heeding, and responsive attention; local divine attribute selects exhaustive hearing and attentive reception, not human obedience
words.prose: {{ar:سَمِيعٌ}} ({{tr:samīʿun}}) is the first predicate of the closing rationale, so hearing is the first divine attribute attached to the command not to advance. The {{ar:س م ع}} ({{tr:s-m-ʿ}}) field gives more than passive sound reception: in this context it marks exhaustive, attentive hearing of spoken or audible pre-emption. Its position before the knowing attribute begins a sequence from received sound to comprehensive knowledge, while the matched final cadence makes the two attributes arrive as one balanced seal. That hearing payoff is immediately concretized by the voice regulation in 49:2.

topics.headline: first predicate hearing
topics.summary: The word stands as the first nominative predicate in the emphatic clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing as the first explanatory attribute following the prohibition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies this word as a predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: intensive attentive hearing
topics.summary: The faʿīl form and listening root family make hearing stable, exhaustive, and attentive in this divine predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the audible side of premature advancement placed under exhaustive divine hearing, while human obeying senses are narrowed to attentive response pressure.
topics.reason: The root family supports hearing and attentive listening, and the local divine faʿīl predicate selects stable intensive hearing rather than a finite act or human obedience.

topics.headline: hearing-to-knowledge sequence
topics.summary: The attribute begins a balanced pair and a perception-to-knowledge closure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing pair cover external sound first and then inward or comprehensive knowledge.
topics.reason: The local order places hearing before knowing, and contextual evidence supports the frequent attribute pair.

topics.headline: cadence and voice bridge
topics.summary: The matched final cadence joins the pair, and hearing anticipates the next ayah's voice regulation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pair as one balanced seal and sees divine hearing prepared for the voice concern in 49:2.
topics.reason: The two final attributes share form and cadence, and the next ayah concretizes hearing through voice regulation.

words.gloss_range: second predicate and final word of the ayah, sealing the command with stable comprehensive divine knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: root field of knowledge, signs, teaching, marks, and the known world; local faʿīl predicate selects stable exhaustive knowledge covering speech, intention, and action
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) lands as the final word and second predicate without a conjunction, so hearing and knowing close as one joined seal. The {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field expands the ending from what is heard to what is fully known, including intentions and signs. Its faʿīl form makes that knowledge stable and exhaustive, giving the last word not to the believers or the messenger but to divine knowledge. The familiar hearing-knowing formula is therefore tailored here to audible pre-emption and inward intention, and the paired cadence makes the final landing feel complete.

topics.headline: second asyndetic predicate
topics.summary: The word is the second predicate of the emphatic clause and follows without a conjunction.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hearing and knowing are predicated together of one subject rather than listed as separate clauses.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies this word as the second predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: comprehensive knowledge field
topics.summary: The root family adds signs, marks, teaching, and known-world pressure while the local word remains the divine knowledge attribute.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing knowledge cover hidden intention, visible signs, and all relevant states, while local grammar keeps the sense as a stable divine attribute.
topics.reason: The root family supports signs and knowledge pressure, and the local faʿīl predicate selects complete stable knowledge.

topics.headline: tailored attribute formula
topics.summary: The frequent hearing-knowing pair is specialized here to speech-act surface and hidden intention.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar divine formula made local to the ayah's regulation of speech, precedence, and intention.
topics.reason: The attribute pair is frequent, and the local command context specializes it to audible and inward dimensions.

topics.headline: final sealing cadence
topics.summary: Final position, paired cadence, and double-predicate grammar make the ending a governing seal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the ayah resolve in divine knowledge after hearing, making the attribute pair the final rationale.
topics.reason: The word is final, shares cadence with the prior predicate, and completes the double-predicate seal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition لا تقدموا and the construction بين يدي الله ورسوله at words 5-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forward motion is held inside an interval already occupied by divine-messenger authority: the addressees must not make their own act, ruling, or speech the leading edge of that sequence, and protective caution maintains the ordering.

activation_trace.role: Beforeward advance supplies the literal motion and models initiative outrunning its proper sequence.
The interval between things supplies the ordered relational space in which precedence can be violated.
Being before the hands fixes that interval as the position immediately in front of an acting presence.
Messenger and message identify the authorized communicative channel whose lead must be preserved.
Self-placement in protective caution makes restraint the mechanism that preserves the sequence.

changed_reading.before: A general command not to get ahead of God and the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: A rule of initiative-ordering: do not place a self-authored act, judgment, or utterance at the front of an authority sequence already in motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from those who have trusted, through the Messenger, to protective caution and the closing hearing-knowing pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust receives what is sent at a deliberate pace; caution acts as a barrier against premature output, while hearing as understanding and knowledge of what becomes clear complete a reception-and-response circuit.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the receptive state from which disciplined response can occur.
Gentleness and deliberate pace give the transmitted command a tempo that the addressee must not outrun.
A barrier warding off harm supplies the control that blocks impulsive response.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception functional rather than merely acoustic.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the fully known state against which premature action is exposed.

changed_reading.before: Believers are told to obey and fear God.
changed_reading.after: Trusted reception has a pace and a guard: understanding must precede response, because the receiving channel is answerable to complete hearing and knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of advance, between, hands, God, and Messenger at words 5-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hand can image authority and one's own act, while between can image an operative tie; the prohibition therefore constrains the insertion of personal rank or agency into the authority field joining divine command and messenger transmission.

activation_trace.role: Prior merit and senior standing supply the status claim that may try to move ahead.
A tie between parties supplies a live connection rather than an empty spatial gap.
Hand as authority makes the position ahead of the hands an intrusion into jurisdiction.
Hands as one's act let the same construction govern deeds as well as opinions or words.
Messenger and message locate the humanly encountered side of the authority relation.

changed_reading.before: Do not stand figuratively in front of sacred authority.
changed_reading.after: Do not insert personal status or self-authored action into the operative authority carried from God through the Messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Comparative volume, lowered voices, calling across an enclosure, and waiting for emergence all materialize precedence as control of access and turn-taking. One advances not only by deciding first but by making authorized speech answer one's volume, timing, or demand.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence supplies the focus motion now realized as taking the first acoustic or temporal turn.
Deliberate pace supplies the tempo that pressured access would override.
Elevation specifically of voice turns abstract advancement into an audible act of self-positioning.
Audible sound supplies the medium in which one voice can be placed over another.
Height as domination supplies the social force carried by placing one's voice above prophetic speech.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies the opposite operation to advancing.
Raised calling supplies an attempt to pull the addressee onto the caller's schedule.
Prevention and enclosure supply a boundary that the call tries to cross without permission.
Holding the self back from agitation supplies the disciplined alternative to forced access.
Passage to the outside supplies the event for which the callers should wait rather than compel.

structural_cues: 49:2 converts precedence into relative volume; 49:3 reverses it by lowering; 49:4-5 move the problem to callers outside an enclosure and prescribe waiting for the Messenger to emerge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acoustic height, enclosure, calling, restraint, and emergence; I infer one mechanism of agenda and access control. A live narrower alternative is that these are separate manners of vocal etiquette rather than a general rule of turn-taking.

changed_reading.before: Do not issue a judgment before sacred authority does.
changed_reading.after: Do not force sacred authority onto your acoustic, conversational, or access schedule; waiting and lowered initiative preserve who sets the next turn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bold self-advancement can damage the efficacy of otherwise real work before the actor has fine awareness of the loss. Protective caution is thus not decorum alone but a defense against an invisible collapse between action and value.

activation_trace.role: Bold forward undertaking supplies the attractive impulse whose cost may remain hidden.
A harm-blocking barrier supplies the preventive function of restraint.
Descent and falling supply the collapse image for works losing efficacy.
Fine awareness and discernment supply the faculty explicitly absent while the loss occurs.

structural_cues: 49:2 places the collapse of works before the agents' awareness of that collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fallen efficacy and absent fine awareness; I infer that self-assertive precedence can silently sever work from worth. The live alternative confines the warning to disrespectful volume in the immediate scene.

changed_reading.before: Advancing is a visible breach of etiquette.
changed_reading.after: Advancing can be a latent failure mode: an apparently successful act may already be losing value before its author can detect the damage.

context_deltas.mechanism: An arriving report must pass through disclosure before it is converted into a targeted effect. Otherwise impulse bridges news directly to impact, and regret arrives only after the harmed reality can no longer be retrieved.

activation_trace.role: Acting before the proper time supplies the focus error now located between report and consequence.
A communicated arriving report supplies the unverified input to the sequence.
Appearance and disclosure supply the verification interval that must not be skipped.
Aimed impact on a target supplies the irreversible output produced from the report.
Impetuous disturbance of composure supplies the mechanism that collapses inquiry into reaction.
Regret over what has passed supplies the delayed signal that the sequence was reversed.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders arrival of news, clarification, possible impact on a people, and retrospective regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a report-to-clarification-to-impact-to-regret chain; I infer that 49:1 governs epistemic latency as well as deference. The alternative is a standalone rule for reports from an unreliable carrier.

changed_reading.before: Do not speak or decide before God and the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: Do not let consequence get ahead of evidence: keep an interval of clarification between incoming information and action upon people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual of the Messenger complying with the group reverses the expected direction of obedience. Advancing can therefore occur when collective preference makes the authorized guide downstream of its demands; hardship is the systems-level result.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence supplies the directional inversion in which followers put their wishes first.
Messenger and message identify the node that the group would wrongly turn into an executor of its preferences.
Agreement and compliance supply the counterfactual reversal: the Messenger accommodating the group.
Consultation and management of opinion supply the domain in which group preference seeks control.
Severe hardship supplies the causal cost of reversing guidance into compliance.
Hitting the right course in conduct supplies the successful orientation opposed to that reversal.

structural_cues: 49:7 explicitly imagines the Messenger obeying the community in much of the matter and predicts hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversed compliance and its hardship; I infer that putting oneself ahead includes making authority responsive to aggregate desire. A narrower alternative reads the verse only as a warning against excessive consultation in that community.

changed_reading.before: Individuals must not preempt the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: A community also advances itself when it pressures the Messenger to ratify its preferences, turning guidance into follower behavior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Non-precedence is not passivity. Once transgression becomes the supplied condition, commanded intervention aims at return, reconciliation, and measured justice; initiative remains subordinate because its trigger, goal, and stopping rule are given rather than self-authored.

activation_trace.role: Premature advance supplies the danger, while the later protocol shows that forward action can become timely.
Warding harm supplies the protective purpose that can require rather than forbid intervention.
Removal of estrangement supplies both the initial and restored endpoint of intervention.
Transgressing the boundary through injustice supplies the condition that authorizes force.
Return and turning back supply the stopping condition for coercive action.
Binding demand supplies the external norm to which the aggressing party must return.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the post-conflict method.
Equity and fair dealing supply the measure preventing authorized action from becoming a new transgression.

structural_cues: 49:9 moves from attempted reconciliation, through conditional force, to return, renewed reconciliation, and justice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trigger, action, stopping point, and repair; I infer that 49:1 forbids self-authored precedence, not timely execution of a received protocol. The live alternative limits this qualification to communal conflict adjudication.

changed_reading.before: Restraint means waiting and avoiding initiative.
changed_reading.after: Restraint means subordinated initiative: wait before authority supplies a condition, then act decisively within its trigger, aim, limit, and measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus hearing-knowing pair expands into a boundary between divine access to hidden reality and human attempts to manufacture that access through suspicion, covert tracking, or briefing God about one's own obedience. Final seeing of deeds closes the asymmetry: humans restrain inference; God does not lack evidence.

activation_trace.role: Premature advance supplies the move from limited signs to a verdict that outruns warranted knowledge.
Actual hearing of sounds supplies one complete mode of divine access contrasted with human surmise.
A thing becoming clear to the knower supplies the epistemic completion humans are warned not to counterfeit.
Accusatory suspicion supplies the unsupported internal verdict.
Secret tracking of reports supplies the attempt to force hidden reality into human possession.
Speaking of a person in absence supplies the social harm produced by pretending epistemic access without presence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the irony of humans presuming to inform the one already knowing.
Obedience and submission supply the claimed inner-religious state humans attempt to report as settled fact.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain explicitly retained within divine knowledge.
Direct sight supplies the concluding evidence mode applied to what people actually do.

structural_cues: 49:12 forbids suspicion and covert inquiry; 49:16 challenges self-report offered as information to God; 49:18 joins knowledge of the unseen to sight of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited human inference-gathering and complete divine hearing, knowledge, and sight; I infer an epistemic jurisdiction within the command not to advance. A live alternative treats these as independent ethical rules joined only by the surah's broad concern with conduct.

changed_reading.before: God hears and knows any act of disobedience.
changed_reading.after: Do not put a humanly manufactured verdict ahead of divine knowledge: neither suspicion, surveillance, nor self-description can occupy God's epistemic position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective differentiation is redirected from a ladder of prior merit into a network of reciprocal recognition. The focus ban on precedence can therefore reach inherited or group-based status claims that present themselves ahead of the divine measure of honor.

activation_trace.role: Prior merit and senior standing supply the precise status form of self-advancement.
Hand as authority locates rank claims before a jurisdiction that alone fixes ultimate standing.
A people-group gathering tribes supplies collective identity without itself supplying superiority.
A group whose members face one another supplies reciprocal social orientation rather than a vertical rank.
Recognition and distinction through a sign supply the stated function of difference: knowing one another.
Commendable honor and generosity supply the value category whose true measure is relocated to God.

structural_cues: 49:13 makes peoples and tribes instrumental to mutual recognition, then locates superior honor at God through protective consciousness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group differentiation, reciprocal recognition, and a relocated honor measure; I infer that the focus's status branch forbids inherited standing from presenting itself as already valid before God. The narrower alternative is an isolated equality rule with no backward effect on 49:1.

changed_reading.before: Do not claim procedural authority before God and the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: Do not front-load inherited seniority, tribal capital, or communal prestige as if it already constituted standing before God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence exposes three premature presentations: a faith-label before inward entry, a religious account before divine knowledge, and a benefaction claim before recognition of who supplied guidance. The focus prohibition thus governs not only action before command but claim before reality and credit before source.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the substantive state against which later verbal claims are tested.
Acting before proper time supplies the temporal grammar for labels and credit arriving before their grounds.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies the standard that self-presentation cannot preempt.
Assent and confirmation supply both the asserted label and the reality whose presence is disputed.
Interior and hidden state supply the destination faith has not yet reached despite the spoken claim.
Heart supplies the inward site that must catch up with the advanced label.
Fulfilling a claim in deed supplies the enacted verification that follows profession.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the reversal of people presuming to teach God their state.
Obedience and submission supply the claimed religious condition offered as a self-certified report.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing one's favor supplies the credit claim that is explicitly reversed.

structural_cues: 49:14 delays faith's entry behind its verbal claim; 49:15 tests truth through enduring commitment; 49:16 rejects informing God; 49:17 reverses who may claim the favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three explicit reversals of claim and ground; I infer a common precedence grammar in which labels, knowledge claims, and moral credit must follow reality and source. The live alternative keeps each reversal local to Bedouin profession, divine omniscience, or boasting.

changed_reading.before: Do not put a decision before divine and prophetic judgment.
changed_reading.after: Do not put profession before inward formation, self-account before divine knowledge, or personal credit before the gift that made faithful response possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus hand-root, so it should appear only as a secondary resonance, not as a lexical replacement. It remains anchored in word 7 and is reinforced by the focus's explicit protective-caution root.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hand-root at word 7 read beside the protective command at word 10.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant protective-barrier branch supplies a secondary image of a boundary before divine-messenger agency.
Warding harm with a barrier independently echoes and contains the unusual hand-root activation.
Forward advance supplies the attempted crossing of that secondary boundary image.

changed_reading.before: Do not move ahead of the hands as an idiom of presence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, do not push through the protective boundary established before divine-messenger agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-domain move from messenger-root looseness and deliberate pace to communicative timing is unusual but branch-backed and anchored in رسول. It should be rendered as a process analogy, while retaining the ordinary messenger sense as primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collision between forward boldness at word 5 and Messenger at word 9.

activation_trace.role: Bold forward undertaking supplies the impulse to accelerate the encounter.
Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a tempo intrinsic to what is sent.
Holding oneself back supplies the human synchronization required by that tempo.
Emergence to the outside supplies the event that arrives on the Messenger's side of the schedule.

changed_reading.before: The Messenger has authority that must be obeyed.
changed_reading.after: The message-mediated encounter also has a pace; advancing is an attempt to accelerate emergence or response beyond that pace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The empty-place branch of the hearing root is idiomatic and branch-distant, so downstream prose should mark this as an evocative resonance. It remains anchored in سميع and gains contextual support from the final pairing of the unseen with direct sight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing سميع عليم at words 14-15.

activation_trace.role: An empty place lacking any human hearer or seer supplies the surprising no-witness scene.
Knowledge through full disclosure prevents the empty human scene from becoming epistemically empty.
Screening from eyes supplies the hidden domain that remains known.
Direct sight supplies the closing counterpoint to the absence of human witnesses.

changed_reading.before: God hears and knows public speech and private intent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command remains operative where no human witness can hear or see: lack of social observation never creates an unobserved interval.

strongest_changes: Precedence became control of timing, volume, access, and conversational initiative rather than decision-order alone.
The report sequence made the command an epistemic latency rule: clarification must remain between news and impact.
The conflict protocol showed that non-precedence is subordinated initiative, not passivity.
Later claims of faith, knowledge, rank, and favor exposed forms of self-presentation that can arrive ahead of their reality or source.
summary.what_was_special: One compact prohibition remained anchored while activating several coexisting mechanisms: acoustic turn-taking, invisible work failure, evidence discipline, reversal of obedience, bounded intervention, epistemic jurisdiction, rank deactivation, and claim-ground ordering. The odd hand-barrier, message-pace, and no-human-witness resonances were retained with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the authority-hand and non-dominant barrier resonances belong in translation or only in exploratory commentary.
How far the authorized-intervention qualification generalizes beyond the conflict procedure of 49:9.
Whether the hearing-knowing epistemic boundary is a deliberate backward linkage or a cumulative contextual echo.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Do not manufacture a leading edge ahead of authority.** ق د م B004 ("beforeward advance and precedence") and B007 ("forepart and leading edge") combine with ي د ي B005 ("hand as authority"). The grammar places human advancing "between/before the hands" of God and messenger. The packet supplies precedence and authority; I infer that premature action tries to become the front edge of a command not yet one's own. The prohibition becomes institutional as well as temporal.
2. **Do not insert one's action into the governing relation.** ب ي ن B003 ("the tie or connection between parties") and ي د ي B009 ("the hands as one's act") activate beside the literal interval of B002. The construction can spatially mark an interval, but the branches also make it a relation occupied by deeds. I infer that self-originated action can obstruct the God-messenger linkage. The ayah then regulates mediation, not merely getting ahead.
3. **Protective listening, not passive silence.** و ق ي B001 ("warding harm off with a protective barrier") assigns *ittaqū* a guarding role, while س م ع B003 ("understanding and compliance") and ع ل م B001 (knowing as clear) specify what the guard preserves. The sequence prohibition -> protection -> divine hearing/knowing is supplied; I infer that restrained initiative keeps human speech answerable to heard instruction. The close reads as an accountability mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:7's hypothetical reversal, in which the messenger obeys communal preference, made the "leading edge ahead of authority" reading much sharper. Then 49:16's challenge about informing God exposed premature action as epistemic presumption as well as procedural precedence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The prohibition governs premature agency, not only physical precedence.** `ق د م:B004` explicitly includes advancing, leading, or acting before the proper time; `ب ي ن:B002` and `ي د ي:B008` make **بَيْنَ يَدَىِ** the space immediately before an authority. In 49:2–4, self-advancement takes the form of voices thrust above or toward the Messenger, whereas 49:5 supplies the corrective act of waiting and 49:6 extends delay into report verification. The packet supplies spatial frontness, vocal initiative, waiting, and verification; I infer that all are instances of controlling who sets an action’s timing. The verse thus reads as a general suspension of self-authorized initiative until the divine-messenger relation has set the course.

2. **The Messenger’s title activates a deliberate tempo.** Alongside the direct messenger/message sense `ر س ل:B002`, the inventory’s `ر س ل:B004` images gentleness, deliberation, and freedom from hurry in action and speech. Its role is sharpened by **صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ** in 49:5 and **فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟** in 49:6. The packet does not itself equate the title with slowness; I infer that the branch image makes the sent message’s proper reception paced rather than impulsive. “Do not advance” consequently includes adopting a messenger-shaped tempo of patient reception.

3. **Divine hearing closes the loophole between private impulse and public act.** `س م ع:B001` is audible hearing, while `س م ع:B003` extends hearing to understanding and compliance; `ع ل م:B001` supplies knowledge opposed to ignorance. The following ayat move from audible volume (49:2–4) to unrecognized moral loss (49:2) and ignorant action on a report (49:6). The packet supplies those outer and inner layers; I infer that **سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ** joins detected speech to known intent and consequence. The command therefore reaches not only visible acts of going ahead but also the unvoiced judgment that authorizes them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 49:16 exposes a non-vocal form of advancing: attempting to teach God one’s religion. This extends `ق د م:B004` from premature external action to premature epistemic judgment; the opening restraint governs who gets to classify faith as well as who sets timing.

baseline.text: Ey iman edenler! Allah'ın ve elçisinin önüne geçmeyin. Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakının. Şüphesiz Allah işitendir, bilendir.

findings.text: Öne geçme yasağı yalnız fiziksel sırayı değil, yetkili yön belirlenmeden zamanı, eylemi veya hükmü kendi başına belirlemeyi de durdurur.
Kişinin kendi eylemini Allah ile elçisi arasındaki yönetici bağın yerine sokması, o bağı perdeleyen bir aracılığa dönüşebilir.
Elçi unvanının ağırbaşlı ve aceleden uzak hareket boyutu, buyruğu almanın sabırlı bir tempo gerektirdiğini gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected interior is approached across a boundary whose crossing must be authorized, patient, and inwardly completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Architectural enclosure becomes a model for reason, piety, pardon, and the difference between an exterior declaration and an admitted interior state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: From Exterior Surrender to Interior Faith
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A declared handover remains external until belief crosses into the protected heart.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; unspoken inner saying `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; belief or opinion held as a saying `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; corrective reversal with "but" `quranic:root_001373:B002/m01`; entry `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; the interior or confidential inside `quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`; handover and surrender `quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`; belief `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; settled safety of the heart `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; heart as the seat of understanding `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, and 17. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_001373:B002/m01` (`ل ك ن`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Speech can carry an inward opinion into public utterance without accomplishing inward admission. The corrective turn interrupts the claim, and the heart remains an interior with its own threshold. Faith must enter and settle there, so declaration reaches the perimeter while conviction may still be outside.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering as Protection and Pardon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vulnerable interior is preserved by shielding, avoidance, and a cover that can also conceal fault.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shielding from harm `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; placing oneself within protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a fault in pardon `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; atonement that covers a wrong `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; moving aside from danger `quranic:root_000262:B003/m01`; reason as a restraining barrier `quranic:root_000296:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: protection occurs at 49:1, 3, 10, 12, and 13; pardon at 49:3, 5, and 14; covering at 49:7; avoidance at 49:12; the chamber root at 49:4.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is assembled from several compatible operations: a barrier restrains approach, the self moves aside from exposure, and a cover prevents injury or covers an already committed fault. Pardon and atonement extend that cover from prevention to repair. The chamber boundary is thus reframed as an ethical technology protecting both what is within and the person who might otherwise trespass.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Acoustic altitude becomes a diagnostic of social rank, yet the surah reverses the expected ladder by locating durable elevation in restraint and protected character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lowering the Acoustic Level
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A voice is raised into audibility, compared with a higher reference line, and deliberately reduced.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:1, 2, 3, and 6.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The relevant action is measurable adjustment, not silence. Breath and articulation produce a voiced sound, the ear receives it, and the speaker places it on a vertical scale beneath the prophetic reference voice. channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: knowing and distinguishing `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; report joined to inward knowledge `quranic:root_000387:B001/m01`; eyesight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; insight of the heart `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; the hidden and absent `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; all parts encompassed as a whole `quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:1, 7, 8, 12, 13, 16, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Seeing, insight, and informed report give human recognition several channels, but each remains sign-dependent. Knowledge of the absent encompasses the whole rather than only the disclosed part. Persons who know one another through marks and reports should therefore not act as though they possess the complete access named at the surah's close.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Reliable knowledge requires controlled passage from arrival or concealment to disclosure, examination, and accountable judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic discipline is materialized as target practice, unmarked terrain, tactile probing, a dawn raid, and the cleaning of a well until what it holds becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Clearing the Well of Evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An obscured source is stripped, cleaned, and opened until its contents can be brought into view.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: unlined well as receptacle `quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`; cleaning a well until its water appears `quranic:root_000269:B008/m01`; stripping or clearing a well `quranic:root_001403:B005/m01`; extracting what was hidden `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; making a matter clear `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; water basin or collection point `quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, and 14.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These latent senses assemble a concrete model of verification. Evidence is not manufactured; an obstructed receptacle is cleared so that what was already present can appear and be drawn out. Making the heart-root itself name a well connects epistemic clearing to interior testing without turning verification into suspicion's invasive probing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Unmarked Ground and Agitated Motion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler without landmarks loses orientation, becomes agitated, and moves before a route has been established.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: impulsive disturbance opposed to composure `quranic:root_000271:B002/m01`; unknown terrain without mark or prior use `quranic:root_000271:B003/m01`; agitation after stillness `quranic:root_000271:B005/m01`; road marker and appointed sign `quranic:root_000051:B005/m01`; traversing land without knowledge `quranic:root_000269:B009/m01`; landmark for orientation `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ignorance is not inert emptiness here. It is an unmarked setting that provokes restless motion: the traveler has neither prior knowledge nor a sign by which to orient. The scene explains why clarification must precede action, because agitation on unknown ground amplifies error rather than resolving it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prohibition on putting oneself forward becomes a procession scene. The front is already occupied, and guidance supplies both direction and a manner of proceeding. Bold advance becomes disorder when it overtakes that position, so valid motion follows rather than manufactures the orientation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a travel operation distinct from rank in the procession. Dispatch initiates motion, the road provides a clear course, and deliberation governs speed. Successive groups can follow because the messenger's progress is steady rather than erratic or panicked.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These senses materialize governed obedience without collapsing it into compulsion. Intellect, tongue, animal motion, and social relation are each held by an appropriate restraint. Bridle and tether check direction, while handover yields control, explaining how external surrender can be real alignment while remaining distinct from inward faith.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Who Obeys Whom
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Followers try to make the messenger conform to their preference, but the proper direction of obedience runs from the community toward the governing command.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a role reversal test. If the messenger becomes the compliant party in every affair, collective preference governs and hardship follows. Right obedience instead trains the self to move readily under a command whose direction it does not invent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authority is not only a superior voice. It is an institutional scene with an affair to manage, command to issue, judgment to delegate, and community to maintain. The city image gives obedience a social architecture in which order depends on care as well as enforceable direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Two parties fight; aggression is restrained, the transgressing party returns, and the divided parties are reconciled.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sequence begins with genuine exposure to death and has an endpoint beyond cessation of combat. A separated faction returns, peace replaces reciprocal force, and reconciliation restores a relation between the parties. Return is the hinge that converts coercive restraint into renewed social connection.

Reconciliation consequently repairs the material that makes the parties relatives in the first place.

Purification removes obscuring matter, and protective settling preserves the refined condition. Restraint of voice can therefore register an interior that has survived testing rather than merely performed compliance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The same covering operation either shelters life or hides truth and received favor from acknowledgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: generic covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; covering seed `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; denial that covers truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; ingratitude that covers favor `quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`; belief `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; unowed gift or favor `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`.

The contrast sharpens the pairing of beloved faith and hated disbelief without reducing the root to a single moral label.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes spoken claims from manufactured ones, and received favor from the laboring hands and spent capacity by which commitment becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Road, Foot, and Intention
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler intends a directed road, puts a foot forward, and advances before the route has been completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; traveler `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; setting out toward intended work `quranic:root_001046:B011/m01`; intention preceding action `quranic:root_001046:B012/m01`; putting forward or preceding `quranic:root_001207:B001/m01`; foot `quranic:root_001207:B005/m01`; advancing on a matter `quranic:root_001207:B010/m01`; directed exertion `quranic:root_000268:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:1, 2, 14, 15, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Commitment has an ordered locomotion: intention points, the foot initiates, and repeated advance carries the agent along a road. This makes the prohibition on advancing in 49:1 structurally relevant to exertion in 49:15: movement is not validated merely by energy, but by its direction and order.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.

Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanın üzerine bastığı ve çoğulu bulunan bilinen beden organını açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu organ anlamını başka anlamlarla karıştırmadan doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ayak organını kapsar; basma eylemini, ayakkabıyı, önceliği veya eskiliği kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın organ anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve aynı kökün yapıya bağlı diğer anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın yere basmasını, ayakta durmasını ve yürümesini sağlayan beden organıdır.

facets.statement: İnsanın yere bastığı bilinen organı ve bu organın tekil türünü belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu anlamı, insanın üzerine bastığı bilinen ayak organı olarak ortak biçimde tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki, yere basma ve yürüme işlevli organın genel ve doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Organın kimliğini ve yere basma işlevini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eş sesli anlamlardan ayrımın özellikle belirtilmesi gereken açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden organı olma özelliğini ve temel işlevini açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Organın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayağın zemine basma eylemini ve basılan yeri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de ayak ile zemin arasındaki temas alanına dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal temas kuran beden organıdır; komşu dal ise organın yaptığı basma eylemini ve bu eylemin yerle ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı bedeninin doğal bir parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayağın altını zeminden koruyan giyilebilir veya takılabilir nesnedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlam da ayağın zeminle karşılaşan alt bölgesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ayak organının kendisini, komşu dal ise ayağı taş ve zeminden koruyan dış nesneyi adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ayak organını biçimsel bir bozukluk varsaymadan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayağın eğrilik veya içe dönüklük durumunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ayak anatomisini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal anatomik parçanın genel adıdır; komşu dal o parçadaki belirli bir biçim bozukluğunu anlatır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: السبق والقدم بمعنى العتق أو الشرف أو الرجوع من السفر أو آلة القدوم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önceden yapılmış işin bıraktığı etkiyi, iyi veya kötü geçmişi, iyilikten doğan yüksek konumu ve önderliği birlikte taşır. Verilen çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak anlam yalnızca olumlu saygınlıkla sınırlandırılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem iyi hem kötü öncül etkiyi kapsar; yüksek mevki, iyilik, hizmet ve önderlik olumlu veya kişiye bağlı özelleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimdeki öncül etki ve mevki ile iyi ya da kötü nitelemeli yapılar ve kişi adlandırmaları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanım, önceden gerçekleşmiş bir işin bıraktığı etkiyi, iyiliği, hizmeti veya seçkin konumu bildirir. Nitelemeli yapılarda bu etki iyi bir paye ya da kötü bir geçmiş olarak özelleşir; kişi adlandırmalarında önderlik ve saygınlık öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Önceden yapılmış bir işin kişi lehine veya aleyhine kalan etkisini ve önceliğini belirtir.
Olumlu bağlamda geçmiş iyilik, hizmet, kalıcı güzel iz, şeref ve yüksek mevki anlamlarını taşır.
Kişi adlandırmalarında başta bulunma, hükümdarlık, önderlik veya saygın kişi olma anlamına yönelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tabanı önceden gelen etki ve önceliktir; bu taban iyilikte güzel iz, hizmet, yüksek mevki ve şeref, kötülükte ise önceden işlenmiş olumsuzluk olarak görünür. Kişi adlarında önderlik ve başta bulunma da bu alana bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Olumlu ya da olumsuz geçmiş etkiyi ve olumlu bağlamdaki kazanılmış mevkiyi birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Önceliği, geride kalan etkiyi ve mevki boyutunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geçmiş iyilik, güzel iz, şeref veya yüksek konum bildiren olumlu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceden kazanılmış olumlu etki ve yüksek konum boyutunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Kötü geçmiş etkisini ve kişi adıyla kurulan önderlik anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumsuz bir geçmişi veya daha önce yapılmış kötülüğün kalan etkisini bildiren bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceden gerçekleşme ve olumsuz etkinin sürmesi özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: İyilik, yüksek mevki, şeref ve önderlik anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: öncül etki, iyilik veya saygın konum

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu toplumsal değer ve saygınlık boyutunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Öncül iyilik veya kötülüğü, somut hizmeti ve önderlik anlamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önceden yapılmış iyi veya kötü işin kalan etkisini ve hizmeti kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki kişi veya şey arasında üstünlük ve fazlalık karşılaştırmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yüksek mevki, değer ve başkasından önde olma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal mevkiyi geçmişteki etki, iyilik veya kötülükle ilişkilendirir; komşu dal ise karşılaştırmalı üstünlük ve erdemi merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geçmiş iyiliği, hizmeti, yüksek mevkiyi ve olumsuz öncül etkiyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanlar arasında yayılan güzel ünü özellikle gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal olumlu bir geçmişin kişiye sağladığı saygınlıkta kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yaygın ün bulunmasa da önceden yapılmış iyilik veya kazanılmış mevkiyi anlatabilir; komşu dalın çekirdeği güzel adın toplumda yayılmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yapılmış işin geride bıraktığı payeyi veya olumsuz etkiyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Cömertlik, barış sağlama ve kan dökülmesini önleme amacıyla etkin çabayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İyilik ve hizmet, kişiye kalıcı bir değer kazandırdığında iki alan kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal iyiliğin önceden oluşmuş etkisini ve payesini, komşu dal ise erdemli işi gerçekleştirmeye yönelik çabayı öne çıkarır.

branches.what_is_ar: القدم والقدمة بمعنى السابقة في الخير أو الشر أو الأثرة الحسنة أو المنزلة أو الشرف أو اليد والمعروف والصنيعة

branches.source_phrase_ar: القدمة والقدم أيضا السابقة في الأمر وللكافرين قدم شر (ayn)؛ القدم أيضا السابقة في الأمر ولفلان قدم صدق أي أثرة حسنة (sihah)؛ قدم الصدق المنزلة الرفيعة والقدم السابقة وكل ما قدمت من خير والعمل الصالح واليد والمعروف والصنيعة والشرف القديم (tahdhib)؛ متقدم على فلان أي أشرف منه (mufradat)؛ لفلان قدم صدق أي شيء متقدم من أثر حسن والملك هو المقدم (maqayis)؛ رجل قدموس سيد وهو ذلك المعنى (maqayis-variant)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin zamanının geçmişte kalmasını, eski oluşu ve sonradan meydana gelmenin karşıtını birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu zamansal varlık sınırını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal geçmiş zamana dayanma ve eski olma durumudur; önde bulunma, saygınlık veya yolculuktan dönüş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eski olma durumu, eski niteliği taşıyan şey ve geçmiş zamanda anlamındaki zaman belirteci ayrı görünümler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin varlığının veya zamanının geçmişe dayanması, yeni ya da sonradan meydana gelmiş olmamasıdır. Zaman belirteci kullanımında olayın önceki bir zamanda gerçekleştiğini bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin zamanının geçmişte kalmasını, eski oluşunu ve sonradan meydana gelmenin karşıtını belirtir.
Zaman belirteci olarak bir olayın geçmişte veya önceki bir zamanda gerçekleştiğini bildirir.
Genişletilmiş bir sözcük biçimi de aynı eski olma niteliğini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eski oluşu geçmiş zamandaki varlıkla ve sonradan meydana gelmenin karşıtıyla açıklar. Ayrıca geçmiş zamanda anlamındaki belirteç ve genişletilmiş bir sözcük biçimi de bu anlam alanına bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin zamanının geçmişe dayanmasını ve yeni ya da sonradan oluşmuş olmamasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçmiş zamana dayanmayı, eski oluşu ve sonradan oluşmama sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın önceki veya geçmiş bir zamanda gerçekleştiğini bildiren zarf bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçmiş zamanda gerçekleşme bilgisini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir varlığın eski olma niteliğini ve sonradan oluşmanın karşıtı olmasını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zamanı geçmişe dayanan bir şeyi niteleyen olağan sıfat bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçmiş zamana dayanma ve yeni olmama niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Geçmiş zamanda anlamındaki belirteç kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonradan meydana gelmenin karşıtını ve geçmişte var olmayı doğrudan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çeşitli nesnelerde uzun zaman geçmesiyle yerleşen eskiliği özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin eski ve uzun süredir var olmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geçmiş zamandaki varlığı ve yeniliğin karşıtını genel bir sınır olarak kurar; komşu dal çoğunlukla üzerinden uzun zaman geçmiş nesne ve maddelerdeki yerleşik eskiliği öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geçmişe dayanan varlığı ve sonradan meydana gelmeme durumunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin yokken sonradan meydana gelmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal varlığın zaman içindeki başlangıç durumunu aynı eksende değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal eski ve önceden var olmayı, komşu dal ise daha önce yokken yeni biçimde meydana gelmeyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir varlığın eski olma niteliğini ve geçmişteki varlığını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Zamanın kendisini uzun bir süre, çağ veya yaşam süresi olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Geçmiş, süre ve zamanın uzaması her iki anlam alanında da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir şeyin zamansal niteliğini eski olarak belirler; komşu dal ise zamanın veya uzun sürenin kendisini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular incelendi; eskilik, sonradan oluşma ve uzun zaman arasındaki temel karşıtlıkları gösteren üç aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: القدم والقديم بمعنى العتق والزمان السالف وخلاف الحدوث والوجود فيما مضى
branches.what_is_not_ar: القدم العضو أو السابقة في الشرف أو القدوم من السفر أو التقدم إلى الأمام
branches.source_phrase_ar: القدم مصدر القديم من كل شيء (ayn)؛ قدم الشيء فهو قديم والقدم خلاف الحدوث وقدما كان كذا (sihah)؛ القدم العتق مصدر القديم وقد قدم يقدم (tahdhib)؛ حديث وقديم والقدم وجود فيما مضى (mufradat)؛ القدم خلاف الحدوث وشيء قديم إذا كان زمانه سالفا (maqayis)؛ القدموس القديم وأصله من القدم (maqayis-variant)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önde bulunma, başkasını geçme, ileri doğru sapmadan sürme ve kimi yapılarda belirlenen zamandan önce davranma özelliklerini açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi bu ilişkisel ilerleme çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göreli öndelik ve ileri harekettir; geçmişten gelen paye, cesaret niteliği veya ön bölüm adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın önde bulunma anlamı ile sapmadan ilerleme ve vaktinden önce davranma bildiren yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin veya şeyin başkasının önünde bulunması, onu geçmesi ya da ileri doğru sapmadan sürmesidir. Belirli bir yapıda, verilen işin zamanından önce yapılmasını da bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin başkasına göre önde bulunmasını ya da öne geçmesini belirtir.
İleri doğru sapmadan, geri dönmeden ve duraksamadan sürmeyi anlatır.
Yapıya bağlı kullanımda bir işi belirlenen zamandan önce yapmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı başkasının önünde bulunma, onu geçme ve ileri doğru dönmeden sürme çevresinde birleştirir. Ön ile arka karşıtlığı bu sınırı destekler; ayrıca belirli bir yapıda zamansal erkencilik anlamı bulunur.

concept_gloss.text: öne geçme, önde ilerleme veya erken davranma
concept_gloss.applicability: Göreli öndeliği, ileri hareketi ve yapıya bağlı zamansal erkenciliği birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Önde bulunma, ileri sürme ve vaktinden önce davranma boyutlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin diğerine göre ön konuma gelmesini anlatan genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasına göre öne çıkma ve ön konuma geçme ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sapmadan ileri sürme ve belirlenen zamandan önce davranma özelleşmelerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hareketin sapmadan, geri dönmeden ve kesintisiz ileri sürmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İleri hareketi ve yön değiştirmeden sürme özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Göreli sıra konumunu ve vaktinden önce davranma anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir buyruğun veya işin belirlenen zaman gelmeden yapılmasını bildiren yapı içinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zamansal sınırdan önce harekete geçme özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Mekansal öndeliği ve kesintisiz ileri hareketi dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Nesnelerin öndeliğini, ileri sürmeyi ve vaktinden önce davranmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya topluluğun başkalarının önüne geçmesini özellikle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya topluluğun diğerlerinden önde bulunmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal daha genel bir öndelik ve ileri hareket alanına sahiptir; komşu dal insan veya topluluğun başkalarını geçmesine yoğunlaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan, topluluk veya şeyler arasındaki genel öndeliği ve erken davranmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: At veya binek hayvanının yarışta öne geçmesini ve hızlı sürüşünü özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yarış veya hareket sırasında başkasının önüne geçmede kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal katılımcı ve bağlam bakımından geneldir; komşu dal binek hayvanının öne geçişi ve süratli yol alışıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin diğerinden önce ve önde bulunmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin diğerinden sonra gelip onun yerini almasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal öğelerin sıra içindeki göreli konumunu aynı zaman ve diziliş ekseninde kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal öne geçme ve önce gelme kutbunu, komşu dal ise arkadan gelme, izleme ve yerine geçme kutbunu temsil eder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Başka bir şeye göre önde olmayı veya öne geçmeyi gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin geçip gitmesini, bir yerden sürmesini veya sona ermesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İleri yönde sürme ve bir hareketin devam etmesi iki dalda buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal göreli ön konumu merkez alır; komşu dal yönsel üstünlük gerektirmeden hareketin geçmesini ve sürmesini anlatır.
